# `mounting_surface` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/mounting_surface.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A mounting surface of an enclosure (doc 03 §16, rank 52, the layout file of its enclosure's space): the plane
carriers and placements sit on. A 2D layout page is a view of one surface (FR-LAY-010). At the MVP an enclosure
holds at most one `plate` surface (WP-S4.01 D3).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `mounting_surface` |
| File | `layout/<space>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 52 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`mounting_surface.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/mounting_surface.schema.json) |

## Types

### Pose3

A pose (doc 05 §3.2): translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a unit quaternion in 10^-9. JSON Schema cannot express that q is unit (within 2.001 x 10^9 of 10^18 squared) and sign-normalised (w > 0, or the first non-zero component positive); the reader rejects both.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | array of (integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000)) (at least 4 item(s), at most 4 item(s)) | yes |  |  |
| `t` | array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 3 item(s), at most 3 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

### SurfaceKind

The kind of a mounting surface (doc 03 §16). Format 0.1 types the mounting plate; door, side, roof, floor and
gland surfaces are kept verbatim as `SurfaceKind::Unknown` until their packages type them.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"plate"` | The mounting plate. |

### SurfacePt2

A point [u, v] in nanometres in the frame of a mounting surface, u to the right, v up (doc 03 §16): not a sheet point.

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
